verdict.rationale: The pack never documents an in-client calendar view, invite responses, or event creation inside Missive. The only calendar mention says external AI apps can act on your calendar through the MCP server, which belongs to the MCP-server story and does not show a user doing these things in the email client. The Office 365/Google sync line refers to contact address books.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can see my calendar, respond to invites, and create events without leaving the email client
